purpose: Help adult educators and trusted Irish space-learning organisations discover the free Mythical Void STEM Creature Lab without contacting children, implying endorsement or using bulk outreach.

criteria: fit with space, inquiry, games or creative STEM

candidates.name: MTU Blackrock Castle Observatory education team
candidates.kind: Irish observatory, science centre and space-education team
candidates.verifiedFit: Its official education page supports school visits, teacher resources and newly developed space activities, and names an adult education team.
candidates.suggestedAngle: Ask for adult educator feedback on the free activity and the right route for sharing an external space-learning resource; do not ask for access to students.

candidates.name: ESERO Ireland teacher-support team
candidates.kind: National space-education office for adult teachers and educators
candidates.verifiedFit: Its official teacher-support page offers classroom resources, teacher workshops and direct support for bringing space into primary and post-primary learning.
candidates.suggestedAngle: Ask whether there is a suitable review route for an independent, free activity that separates real space observation from fictional creature design and a testable prediction.

candidates.name: Research Ireland Curious Minds
candidates.verifiedFit: The programme supports teachers with hands-on, inquiry-based STEM resources and publishes a professional contact for the Curious Minds team.
candidates.suggestedAngle: Hold as an alternative to ESERO rather than contacting two linked Research Ireland teams at once; ask for the correct resource-review route, not endorsement.

candidates.name: Science Week Ireland 2026
candidates.kind: National public science programme and event calendar
candidates.verifiedFit: Science Week runs from 8 to 15 November 2026, has Water as its published theme and accepts event-calendar submissions through its official site.
candidates.suggestedAngle: Opportunity watch only. A future adult-led activity could connect water, alien environments and testable organism adaptations, but Mythical does not yet have an approved event to submit.

contactRule: If Kevin later approves outreach, send one message at a time. Learn from the first response before sending the next, and do not contact RC-013 as well as RC-012 without a distinct reason.
truthAndSafetyRules: Contact adult professional teams only through routes published on their official websites.
Do not contact a school, teacher, club, parent or child privately from this research list.
Do not collect children's names, ages, work, images, voices, schools, locations or contact details.
Do not imply review, approval, partnership or endorsement by NASA, ESA, ESERO, Research Ireland or an observatory.
Describe the activity as independent, free and adult-led for younger designers.
Do not attach files on first contact; use the owned activity and press-room links.
Stop after one unanswered follow-up, no sooner than seven days after the first message.
